in_marathi.name: Vola
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vola हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vola is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vayu', which means wind or air. In Hindu mythology, Vayu is considered as the god of wind, and is one of the eight primary aspects of Lord Shiva. The name Vola is often given to girls born on a windy day or during a windy season.
